why_no_town_plan: the bots plan the town themselves: no orientation, size or plot is handed to them (the release reads a seed file only from the town's own directory, and none is put there)

site.name: D Birch Loop
site.ground_at_home: grass_block at y 71 (dirt below, air above), read from the server 11-14; the bots stand at y 72
site.note: the scouted centre itself fails the town-plan limits (core relief 7 > 5, 9.7% wet > 3%); the one candidate of nine that passes is 48 blocks to its south-east

world_rules: scripts/place-town.py world_rules through infra/showcase/pregen.py, as on every project world: the standard gamerules, world spawn at the home, border centred on the home (radius 5000), chunks pre-generated to 1,024 blocks; no block was placed or removed
